# Training function with 8× B200 GPUs
@stub.function(
    gpu="B200:8",
    memory=512_000,  # 512GB RAM
    timeout=86400,  # 24 hours
    image=image,
    mounts=[zig_encoder, futhark_flow, halide_upsampler, bend_refiner, spiral_kernels],
    volumes={"/weights": weights_volume},

)
def train_model(
    steps: int = 1_000_000,
    batch_size: int = 32,
    learning_rate: float = 1e-4,
    checkpoint_every: int = 10_000
):
    """Complete training loop using all 8 B200 GPUs"""
    import ctypes
    import torch
    import torch.distributed as dist
    import os
    
    # Initialize distributed training (NCCL backend for 8 GPUs)
    dist.init_process_group(
        backend="nccl",
        init_method="env://",
        world_size=8,
        rank=int(os.environ.get("RANK", 0))
    )
    
    # Load compiled libraries
    encoder_lib = ctypes.CDLL("/root/lib/libencoder.so")
    flow_lib = ctypes.CDLL("/root/lib/libflow_generator.so")
    upsampler_lib = ctypes.CDLL("/root/lib/libcoupling_upsampler.so")
    training_lib = ctypes.CDLL("/root/lib/libtraining_kernels.so")
    
    # Load HVM2 runtime for Bend
    import subprocess
    bend_runtime = subprocess.Popen([
        "hvm", "run", "/root/lib/bend_refiner.hvm"
    ], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    
    # Initialize model components on each GPU
    rank = dist.get_rank()
    device = torch.device(f"cuda:{rank}")
    
    # GPU allocation strategy across 8 B200 GPUs
    # B200 specs: 180GB HBM3e per GPU, 8TB/s bandwidth, 4.5 PFLOPS FP8
    # Total system: 1.44TB VRAM, 64TB/s aggregate bandwidth
    
    if rank == 0:
        print(f"Training on 8× B200 GPUs")
        print(f"Total VRAM: 1.44TB")
        print(f"Aggregate bandwidth: 64TB/s")
        print(f"Total compute: 36 PFLOPS (FP8)")
    
    # Load dataset with distributed sampler
    from src.data.dataset_config import MultiDatasetLoader
    
    dataset_loader = MultiDatasetLoader(
        batch_size=batch_size // 8,  # 4 samples per GPU
        num_workers=16
    )
    
    dataloader = dataset_loader.create_dataloader()
    
    # Distributed data sampler
    from torch.utils.data.distributed import DistributedSampler
    sampler = DistributedSampler(
        dataloader.dataset,
        num_replicas=8,
        rank=rank,
        shuffle=True
    )
    
    # Initialize model components with FP16/FP8 mixed precision
    # Use NVIDIA Transformer Engine for automatic FP8 casting
    from transformer_engine.pytorch import fp8_autocast, fp8_model_init
    
    # Text Encoder (DDL) - 3.5GB VRAM per GPU
    text_encoder = DDLTextEncoder(
        vocab_size=50000,
        embed_dim=512,
        num_layers=24,
        num_heads=8
    ).to(device)
    
    # Multi-lane Bridge (mHC) - 1.2GB VRAM per GPU
    mhc_bridge = ManifoldConstrainedBridge(
        num_lanes=4,
        lane_dim=128,
        total_dim=512
    ).to(device)
    
    # Flow Generator (CFM) - 8.5GB VRAM per GPU
    flow_generator = RectifiedFlowGenerator(
        latent_channels=4,
        latent_resolution=64,
        unet_channels=[128, 256, 512, 1024],
        num_flow_steps=12
    ).to(device)
    
    # Upsampler - loaded as Halide JIT compiled module
    # Runs on GPU with auto-scheduled kernels
    upsampler = HalideUpsamplerModule(
        input_size=64,
        output_size=1024,
        num_stages=4
    ).to(device)
    
    # Refiner (Bend) - communicates via HVM2 runtime
    # Parallel processing of all pixels simultaneously
    refiner_interface = BendRefinerInterface(
        runtime_process=bend_runtime,
        num_pixels=1024*1024,
        feature_dim=512
    )
    
    # Wrap all models with DistributedDataParallel
    text_encoder = torch.nn.parallel.DistributedDataParallel(
        text_encoder,
        device_ids=[rank],
        output_device=rank,
        find_unused_parameters=False,
        gradient_as_bucket_view=True,  # Memory optimization
        bucket_cap_mb=25  # NCCL communication bucket size
    )
    
    mhc_bridge = torch.nn.parallel.DistributedDataParallel(
        mhc_bridge,
        device_ids=[rank],
        output_device=rank
    )
    
    flow_generator = torch.nn.parallel.DistributedDataParallel(
        flow_generator,
        device_ids=[rank],
        output_device=rank,
        bucket_cap_mb=100  # Larger buckets for bigger model
    )
    
    # Optimizer: AdamW with weight decay
    # Separate optimizers for different components
    optimizer_encoder = torch.optim.AdamW(
        text_encoder.parameters(),
        lr=learning_rate,
        betas=(0.9, 0.999),
        weight_decay=0.01,
        eps=1e-8
    )
    
    optimizer_bridge = torch.optim.AdamW(
        mhc_bridge.parameters(),
        lr=learning_rate,
        betas=(0.9, 0.999),
        weight_decay=0.01
    )
    
    optimizer_flow = torch.optim.AdamW(
        flow_generator.parameters(),
        lr=learning_rate * 0.5,  # Lower LR for flow model
        betas=(0.9, 0.999),
        weight_decay=0.01
    )
    
    # Learning rate scheduler: linear warmup + cosine decay
    from torch.optim.lr_scheduler import CosineAnnealingLR
    
    def warmup_lr_lambda(step):
        warmup_steps = 10_000
        if step < warmup_steps:
            return step / warmup_steps
        return 1.0
    
    scheduler_encoder = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.LambdaLR(
        optimizer_encoder, warmup_lr_lambda
    )
    
    scheduler_bridge = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.LambdaLR(
        optimizer_bridge, warmup_lr_lambda
    )
    
    scheduler_flow = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.LambdaLR(
        optimizer_flow, warmup_lr_lambda
    )
    
    # Mixed precision training with GradScaler
    # B200 supports FP8/FP16/FP32 with Tensor Cores
    scaler = torch.cuda.amp.GradScaler(
        init_scale=2**16,
        growth_factor=2.0,
        backoff_factor=0.5,
        growth_interval=2000
    )
    
    # Perceptual loss network (VGG features)
    from torchvision.models import vgg19
    vgg_model = vgg19(pretrained=True).features[:22].to(device).eval()
    for param in vgg_model.parameters():
        param.requires_grad = False
    
    # Discriminator for adversarial loss (optional)
    discriminator = PatchDiscriminator(
        input_channels=3,
        base_channels=64,
        num_layers=4
    ).to(device)
    
    discriminator = torch.nn.parallel.DistributedDataParallel(
        discriminator,
        device_ids=[rank],
        output_device=rank
    )
    
    optimizer_disc = torch.optim.AdamW(
        discriminator.parameters(),
        lr=learning_rate * 0.5,
        betas=(0.9, 0.999)
    )
    
    # Training loop
    global_step = 0
    epoch = 0
    
    # Load checkpoint if exists
    checkpoint_path = "/weights/latest_checkpoint.pt"
    if os.path.exists(checkpoint_path):
        if rank == 0:
            print(f"Loading checkpoint from {checkpoint_path}")
        
        checkpoint = torch.load(checkpoint_path, map_location=device)
        
        text_encoder.module.load_state_dict(checkpoint['encoder'])
        mhc_bridge.module.load_state_dict(checkpoint['bridge'])
        flow_generator.module.load_state_dict(checkpoint['flow'])
        
        optimizer_encoder.load_state_dict(checkpoint['opt_encoder'])
        optimizer_bridge.load_state_dict(checkpoint['opt_bridge'])
        optimizer_flow.load_state_dict(checkpoint['opt_flow'])
        
        global_step = checkpoint['step']
        epoch = checkpoint['epoch']
        
        if rank == 0:
            print(f"Resumed from step {global_step}, epoch {epoch}")
    
    # Asynchronous checkpoint saver (runs in background)
    import threading
    checkpoint_queue = []
    checkpoint_lock = threading.Lock()
    
    def async_checkpoint_saver():
        """Background thread that saves checkpoints without blocking training"""
        while True:
            if checkpoint_queue:
                with checkpoint_lock:
                    if checkpoint_queue:
                        ckpt_data = checkpoint_queue.pop(0)
                        torch.save(ckpt_data, f"/weights/checkpoint_step_{ckpt_data['step']}.pt")
                        
                        # Keep only last 5 checkpoints
                        import glob
                        checkpoints = sorted(glob.glob("/weights/checkpoint_step_*.pt"))
                        if len(checkpoints) > 5:
                            os.remove(checkpoints[0])
            
            time.sleep(1)
    
    if rank == 0:
        checkpoint_thread = threading.Thread(target=async_checkpoint_saver, daemon=True)
        checkpoint_thread.start()
    
    # Main training loop
    while global_step < steps:
        epoch += 1
        sampler.set_epoch(epoch)
        
        for batch_idx, batch in enumerate(dataloader):
            # Move batch to GPU
            images = batch['image'].to(device, non_blocking=True)  # [B, 3, 1024, 1024]
            captions = batch['tokens'].to(device, non_blocking=True)  # [B, 77]
            
            # Forward pass with mixed precision (FP16/FP8)
            with torch.cuda.amp.autocast(dtype=torch.float16):
                # 1. Text Encoding (DDL)
                text_embeddings = text_encoder(captions)  # [B, 512]
                
                # 2. Multi-Lane Bridge (mHC)
                # Generate noise for flow matching
                noise = torch.randn(
                    images.shape[0], 4, 64, 64,
                    device=device, dtype=torch.float16
                )
                
                # Condition noise on text embeddings
                conditioned_latent = mhc_bridge(text_embeddings, noise)  # [B, 4, 64, 64]
                
                # 3. Flow Matching (CFM)
                # Sample random timestep for rectified flow
                t = torch.rand(images.shape[0], device=device, dtype=torch.float16)
                
                # Compute target latents from images (using pre-trained VAE encoder)
                with torch.no_grad():
                    target_latents = vae_encode(images)  # [B, 4, 64, 64]
                
                # Linear interpolation for rectified flow
                z_t = t.view(-1, 1, 1, 1) * target_latents + \
                      (1 - t.view(-1, 1, 1, 1)) * noise
                
                # Predict velocity field
                predicted_velocity = flow_generator(z_t, t, text_embeddings)
                
                # Ground truth velocity (straight line from noise to target)
                target_velocity = target_latents - noise
                
                # Flow matching loss (MSE)
                flow_loss = torch.nn.functional.mse_loss(
                    predicted_velocity, target_velocity
                )
                
                # 4. Upsampling (Halide - only for validation)
                # During training, we work in latent space
                # Upsampler is applied during inference
                
                # 5. Perceptual Loss (on decoded images)
                if global_step % 100 == 0:  # Compute every 100 steps
                    # Decode latents to images
                    with torch.no_grad():
                        generated_images = vae_decode(predicted_velocity)
                    
                    # Extract VGG features
                    real_features = vgg_model(images)
                    fake_features = vgg_model(generated_images)
                    
                    perceptual_loss = torch.nn.functional.mse_loss(
                        fake_features, real_features
                    )
                else:
                    perceptual_loss = torch.tensor(0.0, device=device)
                
                # 6. Adversarial Loss (optional, for realism)
                if global_step > 50_000:  # Start after 50k steps
                    disc_real = discriminator(images)
                    disc_fake = discriminator(generated_images.detach())
                    
                    # Hinge loss for discriminator
                    disc_loss = torch.nn.functional.relu(1.0 - disc_real).mean() + \
                                torch.nn.functional.relu(1.0 + disc_fake).mean()
                    
                    # Generator adversarial loss
                    gen_adv_loss = -discriminator(generated_images).mean()
                else:
                    disc_loss = torch.tensor(0.0, device=device)
                    gen_adv_loss = torch.tensor(0.0, device=device)
                
                # Total loss
                total_loss = (
                    1.0 * flow_loss +
                    0.1 * perceptual_loss +
                    0.01 * gen_adv_loss
                )
            
            # Backward pass with gradient scaling
            optimizer_encoder.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            optimizer_bridge.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            optimizer_flow.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            
            scaler.scale(total_loss).backward()
            
            # Gradient clipping (prevent explosion)
            scaler.unscale_(optimizer_encoder)
            scaler.unscale_(optimizer_bridge)
            scaler.unscale_(optimizer_flow)
            
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(text_encoder.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(mhc_bridge.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(flow_generator.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
            
            # Optimizer step
            scaler.step(optimizer_encoder)
            scaler.step(optimizer_bridge)
            scaler.step(optimizer_flow)
            scaler.update()
            
            # Update discriminator (separate backward pass)
            if global_step > 50_000:
                optimizer_disc.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
                scaler.scale(disc_loss).backward()
                scaler.step(optimizer_disc)
            
            # Learning rate scheduling
            scheduler_encoder.step()
            scheduler_bridge.step()
            scheduler_flow.step()
            
            # Logging
            if rank == 0 and global_step % 100 == 0:
                print(f"Step {global_step}/{steps} | "
                      f"Flow Loss: {flow_loss.item():.4f} | "
                      f"Perceptual: {perceptual_loss.item():.4f} | "
                      f"Adversarial: {gen_adv_loss.item():.4f} | "
                      f"LR: {optimizer_flow.param_groups[0]['lr']:.6f}")
            
            # Checkpointing (asynchronous)
            if rank == 0 and global_step % checkpoint_every == 0:
                # Copy model states to CPU (non-blocking)
                checkpoint_data = {
                    'step': global_step,
                    'epoch': epoch,
                    'encoder': text_encoder.module.state_dict(),
                    'bridge': mhc_bridge.module.state_dict(),
                    'flow': flow_generator.module.state_dict(),
                    'opt_encoder': optimizer_encoder.state_dict(),
                    'opt_bridge': optimizer_bridge.state_dict(),
                    'opt_flow': optimizer_flow.state_dict(),
                    'scaler': scaler.state_dict()
                }
                
                # Add to queue for background saving
                with checkpoint_lock:
                    checkpoint_queue.append(checkpoint_data)
                
                print(f"Checkpoint queued for step {global_step}")
            
            global_step += 1
            
            if global_step >= steps:
                break
    
    # Final checkpoint
    if rank == 0:
        final_checkpoint = {
            'step': global_step,
            'epoch': epoch,
            'encoder': text_encoder.module.state_dict(),
            'bridge': mhc_bridge.module.state_dict(),
            'flow': flow_generator.module.state_dict()
        }
        
        torch.save(final_checkpoint, "/weights/final_model.pt")
        print("Training complete! Final model saved.")
    
    # Cleanup
    dist.destroy_process_group()

@stub.function(
    gpu="B200:1",  # Single B200 for inference
    memory=64_000,  # 64GB RAM
    image=image,
    mounts=[zig_encoder, futhark_flow, halide_upsampler, bend_refiner],
    volumes={"/weights": weights_volume}
)
def generate_image(
    prompt: str,
    num_inference_steps: int = 12,
    guidance_scale: float = 7.5,
    seed: int = 42
) -> bytes:
    """Generate image from text prompt"""
    import torch
    import numpy as np
    from PIL import Image
    import io
    
    device = torch.device("cuda:0")
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    
    # Load models
    text_encoder = DDLTextEncoder().to(device).eval()
    mhc_bridge = ManifoldConstrainedBridge().to(device).eval()
    flow_generator = RectifiedFlowGenerator().to(device).eval()
    
    # Load weights
    checkpoint = torch.load("/weights/final_model.pt", map_location=device)
    text_encoder.load_state_dict(checkpoint['encoder'])
    mhc_bridge.load_state_dict(checkpoint['bridge'])
    flow_generator.load_state_dict(checkpoint['flow'])
    
    # Tokenize prompt
    tokens = tokenize(prompt, max_length=77).to(device)
    
    with torch.no_grad():
        # Encode text
        text_embeddings = text_encoder(tokens)
        
        # Classifier-free guidance (generate unconditional embedding)
        uncond_tokens = tokenize("", max_length=77).to(device)
        uncond_embeddings = text_encoder(uncond_tokens)
        
        # Initial noise
        latent = torch.randn(1, 4, 64, 64, device=device, dtype=torch.float16)
        
        # Rectified flow sampling (Euler method)
        dt = 1.0 / num_inference_steps
        
        for i in range(num_inference_steps):
            t = torch.tensor([i * dt], device=device, dtype=torch.float16)
            
            # Conditional velocity
            velocity_cond = flow_generator(latent, t, text_embeddings)
            
            # Unconditional velocity
            velocity_uncond = flow_generator(latent, t, uncond_embeddings)
            
            # Classifier-free guidance
            velocity = velocity_uncond + guidance_scale * (velocity_cond - velocity_uncond)
            
            # Euler step
            latent = latent + dt * velocity
        
        # Decode latent to image (VAE decoder)
        image_tensor = vae_decode(latent)  # [1, 3, 64, 64]
        
        # Upsample to 1024×1024 (Halide)
        image_upsampled = halide_upsample(
            image_tensor,
            text_embeddings,
            target_size=1024
        )  # [1, 3, 1024, 1024]
        
        # Refine with Bend (pixel-level refinement)
        image_refined = bend_refine(
            image_upsampled,
            text_embeddings
        )
        
        # Convert to PIL Image
        image_np = image_refined[0].cpu().numpy().transpose(1, 2, 0)
        image_np = ((image_np + 1) / 2 * 255).clip(0, 255).astype(np.uint8)
        pil_image = Image.fromarray(image_np)
        
        # Save to bytes
        img_byte_arr = io.BytesIO()
        pil_image.save(img_byte_arr, format='PNG')
        img_byte_arr.seek(0)
        
        return img_byte_arr.read()

# Image-to-image function
@stub.function(
    gpu="B200:1",
    memory=64_000,
    image=image,
    mounts=[zig_encoder, futhark_flow, halide_upsampler, bend_refiner],
    volumes={"/weights": weights_volume}
)
def image_to_image(
    input_image_bytes: bytes,
    prompt: str,
    strength: float = 0.7,  # How much to modify (0=no change, 1=complete regeneration)
    num_inference_steps: int = 12,
    guidance_scale: float = 7.5,
    seed: int = 42
) -> bytes:
    """Transform existing image based on text prompt"""
    import torch
    import numpy as np
    from PIL import Image
    import io
    
    device = torch.device("cuda:0")
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    
    # Load models
    text_encoder = DDLTextEncoder().to(device).eval()
    mhc_bridge = ManifoldConstrainedBridge().to(device).eval()
    flow_generator = RectifiedFlowGenerator().to(device).eval()
    
    # Load weights
    checkpoint = torch.load("/weights/final_model.pt", map_location=device)
    text_encoder.load_state_dict(checkpoint['encoder'])
    mhc_bridge.load_state_dict(checkpoint['bridge'])
    flow_generator.load_state_dict(checkpoint['flow'])
    
    # Load and preprocess input image
    input_image = Image.open(io.BytesIO(input_image_bytes)).convert('RGB')
    input_image = input_image.resize((1024, 1024), Image.LANCZOS)
    
    input_tensor = torch.from_numpy(np.array(input_image)).float() / 255.0
    input_tensor = input_tensor.permute(2, 0, 1).unsqueeze(0).to(device)
    input_tensor = input_tensor * 2 - 1  # Normalize to [-1, 1]
    
    # Tokenize prompt
    tokens = tokenize(prompt, max_length=77).to(device)
    
    with torch.no_grad():
        # Encode text
        text_embeddings = text_encoder(tokens)
        
        # Encode input image to latent space
        latent_input = vae_encode(input_tensor)  # [1, 4, 64, 64]
        
        # Add noise based on strength
        noise = torch.randn_like(latent_input)
        
        # Start from partially noised latent
        # strength=0 → start from original, strength=1 → start from pure noise
        start_step = int((1 - strength) * num_inference_steps)
        t_start = start_step / num_inference_steps
        
        latent = t_start * latent_input + (1 - t_start) * noise
        
        # Rectified flow sampling from t_start to 1.0
        dt = (1.0 - t_start) / (num_inference_steps - start_step)
        
        uncond_tokens = tokenize("", max_length=77).to(device)
        uncond_embeddings = text_encoder(uncond_tokens)
        
        for i in range(start_step, num_inference_steps):
            t = torch.tensor([i * dt + t_start], device=device, dtype=torch.float16)
            
            velocity_cond = flow_generator(latent, t, text_embeddings)
            velocity_uncond = flow_generator(latent, t, uncond_embeddings)
            
            velocity = velocity_uncond + guidance_scale * (velocity_cond - velocity_uncond)
            
            latent = latent + dt * velocity
        
        # Decode and upsample
        image_tensor = vae_decode(latent)
        image_upsampled = halide_upsample(image_tensor, text_embeddings, target_size=1024)
        
        # Semantic editing with Bend refiner
        # Uses preservation mask to keep certain regions unchanged
        preservation_mask = compute_preservation_mask(
            input_tensor,
            image_upsampled,
            similarity_threshold=0.8
        )
        
        image_refined = bend_preserve_refine(
            source_img=input_tensor,
            generated_img=image_upsampled,
            preservation_mask=preservation_mask,
            text_embeddings=text_embeddings
        )
        
        # Convert to PIL Image
        image_np = image_refined[0].cpu().numpy().transpose(1, 2, 0)
        image_np = ((image_np + 1) / 2 * 255).clip(0, 255).astype(np.uint8)
        pil_image = Image.fromarray(image_np)
        
        # Save to bytes
        img_byte_arr = io.BytesIO()
        pil_image.save(img_byte_arr, format='PNG')
        img_byte_arr.seek(0)
        
        return img_byte_arr.read()

# Web API endpoint
@stub.function(
    image=image,
    volumes={"/weights": weights_volume}
)
@modal.asgi_app()
def fastapi_app():
    """FastAPI web server for text-to-image and image-to-image generation"""
    from fastapi import FastAPI, File, UploadFile, Form
    from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse
    import io
    
    app = FastAPI(title="Extreme Text-to-Image Generator")
    
    @app.post("/generate")
    async def generate(
        prompt: str = Form(...),
        num_steps: int = Form(12),
        guidance: float = Form(7.5),
        seed: int = Form(42)
    ):
        """Generate image from text prompt"""
        image_bytes = generate_image.remote(
            prompt=prompt,
            num_inference_steps=num_steps,
            guidance_scale=guidance,
            seed=seed
        )
        
        return StreamingResponse(
            io.BytesIO(image_bytes),
            media_type="image/png"
        )
    
    @app.post("/img2img")
    async def img2img(
        image: UploadFile = File(...),
        prompt: str = Form(...),
        strength: float = Form(0.7),
        num_steps: int = Form(12),
        guidance: float = Form(7.5),
        seed: int = Form(42)
    ):
        """Transform image based on text prompt"""
        input_bytes = await image.read()
        
        output_bytes = image_to_image.remote(
            input_image_bytes=input_bytes,
            prompt=prompt,
            strength=strength,
            num_inference_steps=num_steps,
            guidance_scale=guidance,
            seed=seed
        )
        
        return StreamingResponse(
            io.BytesIO(output_bytes),
            media_type="image/png"
        )
    
    @app.get("/health")
    async def health():
        return {"status": "healthy"}
    
    return app

@stub.local_entrypoint()
def main(
    command: str = "train",
    steps: int = 1_000_000,
    batch_size: int = 32,
    learning_rate: float = 1e-4
):
    """Main entry point for training and inference"""
    
    if command == "train":
        print(f"Starting training on 8× B200 GPUs")
        print(f"Steps: {steps}, Batch size: {batch_size}, LR: {learning_rate}")
        
        train_model.remote(
            steps=steps,
            batch_size=batch_size,
            learning_rate=learning_rate,
            checkpoint_every=10_000
        )

pub const DeltaOperator = struct {
    dimension: usize,
    beta_gate: *BetaGateNetwork,
    reflection_vector: *ReflectionVectorNetwork,
    
    // GPU memory
    device_input: [*]f32,
    device_output: [*]f32,
    device_householder_matrix: [*]f32,
    
    // CUDA streams for async operations
    compute_stream: cuda.Stream,
    memory_stream: cuda.Stream,
    
    allocator: std.mem.Allocator,
    
    pub fn init(allocator: std.mem.Allocator, dim: usize) !*DeltaOperator {
        var self = try allocator.create(DeltaOperator);
        
        self.dimension = dim;
        self.allocator = allocator;
        
        // Initialize sub-networks
        self.beta_gate = try BetaGateNetwork.init(allocator, dim);
        self.reflection_vector = try ReflectionVectorNetwork.init(allocator, dim);
        
        // Allocate GPU memory
        _ = c.cudaMalloc(@ptrCast(**anyopaque, &self.device_input), dim * @sizeOf(f32));
        _ = c.cudaMalloc(@ptrCast(**anyopaque, &self.device_output), dim * @sizeOf(f32));
        _ = c.cudaMalloc(@ptrCast(**anyopaque, &self.device_householder_matrix), 
                        dim * dim * @sizeOf(f32));
        
        // Create CUDA streams
        _ = c.cudaStreamCreate(&self.compute_stream);
        _ = c.cudaStreamCreate(&self.memory_stream);
        
        return self;
    }
    
    pub fn forward(self: *DeltaOperator, input: []const f32, output: []f32) !void {
        // Copy input to GPU (async)
        _ = c.cudaMemcpyAsync(
            self.device_input,
            input.ptr,
            self.dimension * @sizeOf(f32),
            c.cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,
            self.memory_stream
        );
        
        // Compute beta gate (scalar value controlling transformation intensity)
        const beta = self.beta_gate.forward(input);
        
        // Compute reflection vector k (direction of transformation)
        var k_vector = try self.allocator.alloc(f32, self.dimension);
        defer self.allocator.free(k_vector);
        
        try self.reflection_vector.forward(input, k_vector);
        
        // Wait for memory transfer
        _ = c.cudaStreamSynchronize(self.memory_stream);
        
        // Compute Householder matrix H = I - β*k*k^T on GPU
        try self.computeHouseholderMatrix(beta, k_vector);
        
        // Matrix-vector multiplication: output = H * input
        try self.matrixVectorMultiply();
        
        // Copy result back to host (async)
        _ = c.cudaMemcpyAsync(
            output.ptr,
            self.device_output,
            self.dimension * @sizeOf(f32),
            c.cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost,
            self.memory_stream
        );
        
        _ = c.cudaStreamSynchronize(self.memory_stream);
    }
    
    fn computeHouseholderMatrix(self: *DeltaOperator, beta: f32, k: []const f32) !void {
        // Launch CUDA kernel to compute H = I - β*k*k^T
        const threads_per_block = 256;
        const blocks = (self.dimension * self.dimension + threads_per_block - 1) / threads_per_block;
        
        // Upload k vector to GPU
        var device_k: [*]f32 = undefined;
        _ = c.cudaMalloc(@ptrCast(**anyopaque, &device_k), self.dimension * @sizeOf(f32));
        _ = c.cudaMemcpy(device_k, k.ptr, self.dimension * @sizeOf(f32), c.cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
        
        // Call kernel
        householder_kernel<<<blocks, threads_per_block, 0, self.compute_stream>>>(
            self.device_householder_matrix,
            device_k,
            beta,
            @intCast(c_int, self.dimension)
        );
        
        _ = c.cudaStreamSynchronize(self.compute_stream);
        _ = c.cudaFree(device_k);
    }
    
    fn matrixVectorMultiply(self: *DeltaOperator) !void {
        // Use cuBLAS for optimized matrix-vector multiplication
        var cublas_handle: c.cublasHandle_t = undefined;
        _ = c.cublasCreate_v2(&cublas_handle);
        _ = c.cublasSetStream_v2(cublas_handle, self.compute_stream);
        
        const alpha: f32 = 1.0;
        const beta: f32 = 0.0;
        
        // y = alpha * A * x + beta * y
        _ = c.cublasSgemv_v2(
            cublas_handle,
            c.CUBLAS_OP_N,  // No transpose
            @intCast(c_int, self.dimension),
            @intCast(c_int, self.dimension),
            &alpha,
            self.device_householder_matrix,
            @intCast(c_int, self.dimension),
            self.device_input,
            1,  // stride
            &beta,
            self.device_output,
            1   // stride
        );
        
        _ = c.cublasDestroy_v2(cublas_handle);
    }
    
    pub fn backward(self: *DeltaOperator, grad_output: []const f32, grad_input: []f32) !void {
        // Backward pass through Delta Operator
        // Gradient computation using chain rule
        
        // grad_input = H^T * grad_output (Householder matrix is symmetric)
        _ = c.cudaMemcpyAsync(
            self.device_output,  // Reuse as temp buffer
            grad_output.ptr,
            self.dimension * @sizeOf(f32),
            c.cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,
            self.memory_stream
        );
        
        _ = c.cudaStreamSynchronize(self.memory_stream);
        
        // Matrix-vector multiply with transpose
        var cublas_handle: c.cublasHandle_t = undefined;
        _ = c.cublasCreate_v2(&cublas_handle);
        _ = c.cublasSetStream_v2(cublas_handle, self.compute_stream);
        
        const alpha: f32 = 1.0;
        const beta: f32 = 0.0;
        
        _ = c.cublasSgemv_v2(
            cublas_handle,
            c.CUBLAS_OP_T,  // Transpose
            @intCast(c_int, self.dimension),
            @intCast(c_int, self.dimension),
            &alpha,
            self.device_householder_matrix,
            @intCast(c_int, self.dimension),
            self.device_output,
            1,
            &beta,
            self.device_input,  // Reuse as temp buffer
            1
        );
        
        _ = c.cudaMemcpyAsync(
            grad_input.ptr,
            self.device_input,
            self.dimension * @sizeOf(f32),
            c.cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost,
            self.memory_stream
        );
        
        _ = c.cudaStreamSynchronize(self.memory_stream);
        _ = c.cublasDestroy_v2(cublas_handle);
        
        // Backpropagate through beta_gate and reflection_vector networks
        try self.beta_gate.backward(grad_output);
        try self.reflection_vector.backward(grad_output);
    }
    
    pub fn deinit(self: *DeltaOperator) void {
        c.cudaFree(self.device_input);
        c.cudaFree(self.device_output);
        c.cudaFree(self.device_householder_matrix);
        
        c.cudaStreamDestroy(self.compute_stream);
        c.cudaStreamDestroy(self.memory_stream);
        
        self.beta_gate.deinit();
        self.reflection_vector.deinit();
        
        self.allocator.destroy(self);
    }
};

pub const BetaGateNetwork = struct {
    input_dim: usize,
    hidden_dim: usize = 256,
    
    // Weights
    weights_1: []f32,
    bias_1: []f32,
    weights_2: []f32,
    bias_2: f32,
    
    // GPU memory
    device_weights_1: [*]f32,
    device_bias_1: [*]f32,
    device_weights_2: [*]f32,
    device_hidden: [*]f32,
    
    allocator: std.mem.Allocator,
    
    pub fn init(allocator: std.mem.Allocator, input_dim: usize) !*BetaGateNetwork {
        var self = try allocator.create(BetaGateNetwork);
        
        self.input_dim = input_dim;
        self.allocator = allocator;
        
        // Initialize weights (Xavier initialization)
        self.weights_1 = try allocator.alloc(f32, input_dim * self.hidden_dim);
        self.bias_1 = try allocator.alloc(f32, self.hidden_dim);
        self.weights_2 = try allocator.alloc(f32, self.hidden_dim);
        
        const std_dev_1 = @sqrt(2.0 / @intToFloat(f32, input_dim));
        const std_dev_2 = @sqrt(2.0 / @intToFloat(f32, self.hidden_dim));
        
        var rng = std.rand.DefaultPrng.init(42);
        
        for (self.weights_1) |*w| {
            w.* = rng.random().floatNorm(f32) * std_dev_1;
        }
        
        for (self.bias_1) |*b| {
            b.* = 0.0;
        }
        
        for (self.weights_2) |*w| {
            w.* = rng.random().floatNorm(f32) * std_dev_2;
        }
        
        self.bias_2 = 0.0;
        
        // Allocate GPU memory
        _ = c.cudaMalloc(@ptrCast(**anyopaque, &self.device_weights_1), 
                        input_dim * self.hidden_dim * @sizeOf(f32));
        _ = c.cudaMalloc(@ptrCast(**anyopaque, &self.device_bias_1), 
                        self.hidden_dim * @sizeOf(f32));
        _ = c.cudaMalloc(@ptrCast(**anyopaque, &self.device_weights_2), 
                        self.hidden_dim * @sizeOf(f32));
        _ = c.cudaMalloc(@ptrCast(**anyopaque, &self.device_hidden), 
                        self.hidden_dim * @sizeOf(f32));
        
        // Copy weights to GPU
        _ = c.cudaMemcpy(self.device_weights_1, self.weights_1.ptr, 
                        input_dim * self.hidden_dim * @sizeOf(f32), 
                        c.cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
        _ = c.cudaMemcpy(self.device_bias_1, self.bias_1.ptr, 
                        self.hidden_dim * @sizeOf(f32), 
                        c.cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
        _ = c.cudaMemcpy(self.device_weights_2, self.weights_2.ptr, 
                        self.hidden_dim * @sizeOf(f32), 
                        c.cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
        
        return self;
    }
    
    pub fn forward(self: *BetaGateNetwork, input: []const f32) f32 {
        // Two-layer MLP: hidden = ReLU(W1*input + b1), output = sigmoid(W2*hidden + b2)
        var hidden = self.allocator.alloc(f32, self.hidden_dim) catch unreachable;
        defer self.allocator.free(hidden);
        
        // Layer 1: hidden = W1 * input + b1
        for (hidden) |*h, i| {
            var sum: f32 = self.bias_1[i];
            
            for (input) |x, j| {
                sum += self.weights_1[i * self.input_dim + j] * x;
            }
            
            // ReLU activation
            h.* = if (sum > 0) sum else 0;
        }
        
        // Layer 2: output = W2 * hidden + b2
        var output: f32 = self.bias_2;
        
        for (hidden) |h, i| {
            output += self.weights_2[i] * h;
        }
        
        // Sigmoid activation to constrain beta in [0, 2]
        // output = 2 * sigmoid(output)
        return 2.0 * (1.0 / (1.0 + @exp(-output)));
    }
    
    pub fn backward(self: *BetaGateNetwork, grad: []const f32) !void {
        // Compute gradients for beta gate network
        // (Implementation details for backpropagation)
        // This would compute gradients w.r.t. weights_1, bias_1, weights_2, bias_2
    }
    
    pub fn deinit(self: *BetaGateNetwork) void {
        self.allocator.free(self.weights_1);
        self.allocator.free(self.bias_1);
        self.allocator.free(self.weights_2);
        
        c.cudaFree(self.device_weights_1);
        c.cudaFree(self.device_bias_1);
        c.cudaFree(self.device_weights_2);
        c.cudaFree(self.device_hidden);
        
        self.allocator.destroy(self);
    }
};

    weights_1: []f32,
    bias_1: []f32,
    weights_2: []f32,

    bias_3: []f32,

    pub fn init(allocator: std.mem.Allocator, input_dim: usize) !*ReflectionVectorNetwork {

        self.weights_1 = try allocator.alloc(f32, input_dim * self.hidden_dim);
        self.bias_1 = try allocator.alloc(f32, self.hidden_dim);
        
        self.weights_2 = try allocator.alloc(f32, self.hidden_dim * self.hidden_dim);
        self.bias_2 = try allocator.alloc(f32, self.hidden_dim);
        
        self.weights_3 = try allocator.alloc(f32, self.hidden_dim * input_dim);
        self.bias_3 = try allocator.alloc(f32, input_dim);
        
        // Xavier initialization for all layers
        var rng = std.rand.DefaultPrng.init(42);
        
        const std_1 = @sqrt(2.0 / @intToFloat(f32, input_dim));
        for (self.weights_1) |*w| w.* = rng.random().floatNorm(f32) * std_1;
        for (self.bias_1) |*b| b.* = 0.0;
        
        const std_2 = @sqrt(2.0 / @intToFloat(f32, self.hidden_dim));
        for (self.weights_2) |*w| w.* = rng.random().floatNorm(f32) * std_2;
        for (self.bias_2) |*b| b.* = 0.0;
        
        for (self.weights_3) |*w| w.* = rng.random().floatNorm(f32) * std_2;
        for (self.bias_3) |*b| b.* = 0.0;
        
        return self;
    }
    
    pub fn forward(self: *ReflectionVectorNetwork, input: []const f32, output: []f32) !void {
        // Three-layer MLP with ReLU activations
        
        var hidden_1 = try self.allocator.alloc(f32, self.hidden_dim);
        defer self.allocator.free(hidden_1);
        
        var hidden_2 = try self.allocator.alloc(f32, self.hidden_dim);
        defer self.allocator.free(hidden_2);
        
        // Layer 1
        for (hidden_1) |*h, i| {
            var sum: f32 = self.bias_1[i];
            for (input) |x, j| {
                sum += self.weights_1[i * self.input_dim + j] * x;
            }
            h.* = if (sum > 0) sum else 0;  // ReLU
        }
        
        // Layer 2
        for (hidden_2) |*h, i| {
            var sum: f32 = self.bias_2[i];
            for (hidden_1) |x, j| {
                sum += self.weights_2[i * self.hidden_dim + j] * x;
            }
            h.* = if (sum > 0) sum else 0;  // ReLU
        }
        
        // Layer 3 (output layer)
        for (output) |*o, i| {
            var sum: f32 = self.bias_3[i];
            for (hidden_2) |x, j| {
                sum += self.weights_3[i * self.hidden_dim + j] * x;
            }
            o.* = sum;
        }
        
        // Normalize output to unit vector (reflection direction)
        var norm: f32 = 0.0;
        for (output) |o| {
            norm += o * o;
        }
        norm = @sqrt(norm);
        
        for (output) |*o| {
            o.* /= norm;
        }
    }

// CUDA KERNEL FOR HOUSEHOLDER MATRIX
// =======================

// CUDA kernel (written in C++ style for embedding)
extern "C" __global__ void householder_kernel(
    float* H,
    const float* k,
    float beta,
    int dim
) {
    int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    int total_elements = dim * dim;
    
    if (idx < total_elements) {
        int i = idx / dim;
        int j = idx % dim;
        
        // H[i,j] = I[i,j] - beta * k[i] * k[j]
        float identity = (i == j) ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
        H[idx] = identity - beta * k[i] * k[j];
    }
}

pub const DDLLayer = struct {
    dimension: usize,
    num_heads: usize,
    
    // Components
    layer_norm: *LayerNorm,
    multi_head_attention: *MultiHeadAttention,
    delta_operator_1: *DeltaOperator,
    feedforward: *FeedForward,
    delta_operator_2: *DeltaOperator,
    
    allocator: std.mem.Allocator,
    
    pub fn init(allocator: std.mem.Allocator, dim: usize, heads: usize) !*DDLLayer {
        var self = try allocator.create(DDLLayer);
        
        self.dimension = dim;
        self.num_heads = heads;
        self.allocator = allocator;
        
        // Initialize components
        self.layer_norm = try LayerNorm.init(allocator, dim);
        self.multi_head_attention = try MultiHeadAttention.init(allocator, dim, heads);
        self.delta_operator_1 = try DeltaOperator.init(allocator, dim);
        self.feedforward = try FeedForward.init(allocator, dim, dim * 4);
        self.delta_operator_2 = try DeltaOperator.init(allocator, dim);
        
        return self;
    }
    
    pub fn forward(self: *DDLLayer, input: []const f32, output: []f32) !void {
        var temp_1 = try self.allocator.alloc(f32, self.dimension);
        defer self.allocator.free(temp_1);
        
        var temp_2 = try self.allocator.alloc(f32, self.dimension);
        defer self.allocator.free(temp_2);
        
        // Layer 1: LayerNorm -> MultiHeadAttention -> DeltaOperator -> Residual
        self.layer_norm.forward(input, temp_1);
        try self.multi_head_attention.forward(temp_1, temp_2);
        try self.delta_operator_1.forward(temp_2, temp_1);
        
        // Residual connection
        for (input) |x, i| {
            temp_1[i] += x;
        }
        
        // Layer 2: LayerNorm -> FeedForward -> DeltaOperator -> Residual
        self.layer_norm.forward(temp_1, temp_2);
        try self.feedforward.forward(temp_2, output);
        try self.delta_operator_2.forward(output, temp_2);
        
        // Residual connection
        for (temp_1) |x, i| {
            output[i] = temp_2[i] + x;
        }
    }
    
    pub fn deinit(self: *DDLLayer) void {
        self.layer_norm.deinit();
        self.multi_head_attention.deinit();
        self.delta_operator_1.deinit();
        self.feedforward.deinit();
        self.delta_operator_2.deinit();
        
        self.allocator.destroy(self);
    }
};

pub const DDLTextEncoder = struct {
    vocab_size: usize,
    embed_dim: usize,
    num_layers: usize,
    num_heads: usize,
    max_seq_length: usize,
    
    // Components
    token_embedding: *TokenEmbedding,
    positional_encoding: *PositionalEncoding,
    ddl_layers: []*DDLLayer,
    final_layer_norm: *LayerNorm,
    
    allocator: std.mem.Allocator,
    
    pub fn init(
        allocator: std.mem.Allocator,
        vocab_size: usize,
        embed_dim: usize,
        num_layers: usize,
        num_heads: usize,
        max_seq_len: usize
    ) !*DDLTextEncoder {
        var self = try allocator.create(DDLTextEncoder);
        
        self.vocab_size = vocab_size;
        self.embed_dim = embed_dim;
        self.num_layers = num_layers;
        self.num_heads = num_heads;
        self.max_seq_length = max_seq_len;
        self.allocator = allocator;
        
        // Initialize embedding layers
        self.token_embedding = try TokenEmbedding.init(allocator, vocab_size, embed_dim);
        self.positional_encoding = try PositionalEncoding.init(allocator, max_seq_len, embed_dim);
        
        // Initialize DDL layers
        self.ddl_layers = try allocator.alloc(*DDLLayer, num_layers);
        for (self.ddl_layers) |*layer| {
            layer.* = try DDLLayer.init(allocator, embed_dim, num_heads);
        }
        
        self.final_layer_norm = try LayerNorm.init(allocator, embed_dim);
        
        return self;
    }
    
    pub fn forward(self: *DDLTextEncoder, token_ids: []const u32, output: []f32) !void {
        const seq_len = token_ids.len;
        
        // Allocate temporary buffers
        var embeddings = try self.allocator.alloc(f32, seq_len * self.embed_dim);
        defer self.allocator.free(embeddings);
        
        var temp = try self.allocator.alloc(f32, seq_len * self.embed_dim);
        defer self.allocator.free(temp);
        
        // Token embedding
        self.token_embedding.forward(token_ids, embeddings);
        
        // Add positional encoding
        self.positional_encoding.forward(embeddings, temp);
        
        // Pass through DDL layers
        var current_input = temp;
        var current_output = embeddings;
        
        for (self.ddl_layers) |layer, i| {
            for (0..seq_len) |j| {
                const start = j * self.embed_dim;
                const end = start + self.embed_dim;
                
                try layer.forward(
                    current_input[start..end],
                    current_output[start..end]
                );
            }
            
            // Swap buffers
            const swap = current_input;
            current_input = current_output;
            current_output = swap;
        }
        
        // Final layer norm
        self.final_layer_norm.forward(current_input, output);
    }
    
    pub fn deinit(self: *DDLTextEncoder) void {
        self.token_embedding.deinit();
        self.positional_encoding.deinit();
        
        for (self.ddl_layers) |layer| {
            layer.deinit();
        }
        self.allocator.free(self.ddl_layers);
        
        self.final_layer_norm.deinit();
        
        self.allocator.destroy(self);
    }
};

./coupling_upsample_generator \

# Compile Bend refiner
cd src/refiner
bend check parallel_refiner.bend
hvm compile parallel_refiner.bend -o ../../build/bend_refiner.hvm

cd src/training
spiral compile spiral_kernels.spi --target cuda --output ../../build/libtraining_kernels.so
